control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during an intrusive maintenance task on G-8101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on G-8101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 27 February 2020 a regulatory notice was issued concerning G-8101 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station following an intrusive maintenance task.
